subject: Salem Street Corridor Rezoning
overview: The Medford City Council met to hold a lengthy public hearing on major zoning overhauls, ultimately approving the Salem Street corridor rezoning and the Green Score environmental regulations. The Council also approved a draft hybrid City Charter and authorized school facility repair requests.

items.title: Condolence Resolution for Maxwell Leiner
items.summary: Approved a resolution extending condolences on the passing of Maxwell Leiner and dedicated the meeting in his honor.

items.title: Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved reports from the Education and Culture Committee, the Planning and Permitting Committee, the Committee of the Whole, and the Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee.

items.title: Common Victualler's License Amendment for Mrs. Murphy's
items.summary: Approved a request to amend Mrs. Murphy's common victualler's license to extend its business hours to 1:00 a.m.

items.title: Public Hearing: Salem Street Neighborhood Corridor District Rezoning
items.summary: Approved the Salem Street Neighborhood Corridor District zoning ordinance with amendments reverting the Salem and Park Street intersection back to Mixed-Use 2 zoning.

items.title: Public Hearing: Green Score Zoning Regulations
items.summary: Approved a new Green Score zoning regulation establishing environmental grading and developer incentives.

items.title: MSBA Accelerated Repair Statements of Interest
items.summary: Approved separate resolutions authorizing the school district to submit Statements of Interest to the MSBA for roof and HVAC repairs at the Brooks, Missituk, and Roberts Elementary Schools.

items.title: Draft City Charter Amendments
items.summary: Approved the draft hybrid City Charter with technical and clarifying amendments to be submitted to the mayor and state legislature.

items.title: FY 2026 Budget Schedule
items.summary: Approved a resolution establishing the schedule and deadlines for the upcoming fiscal year 2026 budget process.

items.title: Tabled Resolutions and Adjournment
items.summary: Tabled two resolutions to the next meeting and heard final remarks during public participation before adjourning.
